description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter (DirectoryEntryAdapter) for displaying directory entries in an Android app. It manages creating view holders, binding directory data to views, and updating the list of directory entries.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying directory entries, managing view holders and binding data.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A view holder class for directory entry items, holding references to views displaying file name, mime type, and icon.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of DirectoryEntry objects.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder by inflating the directory item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from mDirectoryEntries at the specified position to the provided ViewHolder, setting text and icon based on mime type.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of directory entries.

methods.name: setDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Updates the adapter's list of directory entries.
